snippet.title: Miaobot Zero Gameplay (Aimbot Route)
snippet.description:
Play the game or download it for Game Boy Color here: https://lydianchord.itch.io/miaobot-zero
Soundtrack: https://lydianchord.bandcamp.com/album/miaobot-zero-soundtrack

This is a demonstration of how to get one of the harder endings in Miaobot Zero. I skipped the dialogue so there aren't any story spoilers.

As you can see, getting hit doesn't matter as long as you still have a barrier up, at least on this route. Also, you don't actually need to defeat every single enemy, I just know how because I made the game lol

#gbstudio #gameboy
